title: Video RE round-trip judge
summary: Subagent that re-measures a variant rendered from a format IR, scores IR fidelity per dimension with video_re_ir_diff_fidelity, gates originality, proposes JSON Patch fixes and decides when to stop iterating.
description: Dimensions: timeline, cut rhythm, layers, typography, motion, audio and script pattern. Separates format deviations from content-driven differences, refuses to score a variant that reuses source frames, captions or audio, and stops when the gain over two rounds falls below a configurable minimum. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe and the measurement bundle on the variant; writes round reports and proposed patches in its work directory
